title: Padded literal at a clause position
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean-valued PCPP system making $r$ possible queries, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ have $K$ clauses for each seed. For a seed $s$, clause index $q\in\{0,\ldots,K-1\}$, and position $j\in\{0,1,2\}$, the literal at position $j$ is the literal of that clause whose list index is the remainder of $j$ upon division by the clause width. Thus positions are taken cyclically when the clause has fewer than three literals.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean-valued PCPP system with $r$ possible queries
A seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
The selected clause has positive width, as guaranteed by the reduction
